info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the Workflow Approval Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033/034). Covers ApprovalPolicy CRUD and the ApprovalRequest lifecycle under /workflow-approval/v1 (initiate, retrieve, decision/capture, control/cancel, audit-log/retrieve), quorum-reached approval, fail-fast veto rejection, cancellation, approval chains (ordered stages, one decision per person, the approver inbox), RFC 7807 error_code assertions (400/404/409) and W3C traceparent correlation. Requires an organisationId environment variable populated from the Party Reference Data Directory Service Domain.
